simple.summary: פַּחְדָּה (pachdâh) means alarm (i.e. awe) First listed occurrence: Jer 2 19.

definitions.full: H6345. pachdah [ מַּחְדָּה ] noun feminine dread, religious awe , suffix אֵלַיִךְ מַּחְדָּתִי לֹא Jer 2:19 no awe of me (came) unto thee.
